capabilities: choose how a pasted URL is inserted (titled link, plain URL, or pill)
edit a link's text and URL from a hover dialog or command
mention notes with @ and search recent notes
pick, filter, or create tags from a # dropdown with usage counts
remove a tag by clicking a hover button
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.13 or later; hover buttons need a mouse or trackpad, so they do not work with touch alone. Each feature can be toggled independently in settings.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in menu for choosing how a pasted URL is inserted, no dialog for editing existing links, and no @-mention or tag-picking popups while typing.

relations.evidence: It inserts an empty-text link [](url), which the Link Mention plugin renders as a favicon-and-title pill.

summary: Editing helper that adds Notion-style link and tag handling: a paste menu for URLs, hover link editing, @-note mentions and a tag picker.
